glosses: trail, spoor (i.e., marked indication to track and follow)
flea market, public market (especially El Rastro in Madrid)

examples.text: La policía buscó por todas partes y no pudo encontrar rastros de Tom.
examples.en: The police looked everywhere and could find no trace of Tom.

examples.text: Los caballos dejaron un rastro muy visible.
examples.en: The horses left a very visible trail.
